intro.en: Rully is the northern Côte Chalonnaise village appellation spanning Rully and Chagny. It produces still Chardonnay-led whites and Pinot Noir-led reds at Village and Premier Cru levels; its 23 Premier Cru climats form the core of this connected reference.
intro.zh: Rully 位于 Côte Chalonnaise 北部，跨 Rully 与 Chagny 两市镇。静态白葡萄酒以 Chardonnay 为主，红葡萄酒以 Pinot Noir 为主；分 Village 与 Premier Cru。本专题逐一关联其 23 个 Premier Cru climat、生产者与酒款。

body.zh: 葡萄种植历史与罗马时期及修道院发展相关；Saint-Bénigne 修道院、Maison de Vergy 与勃艮第公爵均见于产区历史。

body.en: AOC recognition came in 1939; the specification dates the first Premier Cru list to 1943. It records approximately 600 ha in 1895, contraction to about 90 ha after the Second World War, and subsequent recovery. These are historical figures.
body.zh: 1939 年获 AOC；规范记载首批 Premier Cru 名单形成于 1943 年。其历史叙述记载 1895 年约 600 ha、二战后约 90 ha，之后逐步恢复；这些均为历史面积。

body.en: Rully has also been an important sparkling-wine centre since the early nineteenth century. This history does not turn Rully AOP into a sparkling-wine appellation.
body.zh: 自 19 世纪初起，Rully 亦是重要的起泡酒生产中心；该历史不改变 Rully AOP 仅涵盖静态酒的规定。

body.en: At the northern end of the Côte Chalonnaise, south of the Côte de Beaune, the appellation spans Rully and Chagny in Saône-et-Loire. The Saône plain lies to the east.
body.zh: 位于 Côte Chalonnaise 北端、Côte de Beaune 以南，覆盖 Saône-et-Loire 省的 Rully 与 Chagny；Saône 平原位于其东侧。

body.en: The specification distinguishes vineyards at 220–300 m from surrounding hills at 250–400 m; the BIVB overview uses 230–300 m. East- and south-facing vineyards dominate, with local west-facing exceptions.
body.zh: 规范区分葡萄园海拔 220–300 m 与周边丘陵 250–400 m；BIVB 概览采用 230–300 m。葡萄园以东向、南向为主，局部亦有西向地块。

body.en: A climat is a delimited vineyard identity. An estate parcel is only part of that climat unless sole ownership is established; an estate area or vine age must not be applied to the whole climat.
body.zh: climat 是具明确界定的葡萄园身份；除有独占证据外，酒庄地块仅为其中一部分。酒庄持有面积或藤龄不能直接代表整个 climat。

body.en: Bourgogne combines oceanic, continental and southern influences. Rully’s specification describes a modified oceanic regime with continental and southern influences, rather than a purely continental climate.
body.zh: 勃艮第同时受海洋性、大陆性与南方气候影响；Rully 规范采用“变性海洋性气候，并受大陆性和南方影响”的描述，并非纯大陆性气候。

body.en: Sunny summers and favourable autumn conditions can assist ripening. Aspect, slope drainage and air movement modify humidity and ripening locally; regional climate averages are not measurements for each climat.
body.zh: 充足夏季日照与适宜秋季条件有利成熟。坡向、坡地排水与空气流动会改变局部湿度和成熟节奏；区域平均气候数据不能作为每个 climat 的实测值。

body.en: Spring frost, rain near harvest and fungal pressure require vintage-specific assessment. The frost-affected 2021 de Villaine Cuvée Ronde is a documented example of a multi-climat release, not a new Premier Cru site.
body.zh: 春霜、采收期降雨与真菌病害须逐年份判断。de Villaine 的 2021 Cuvée Ronde 是霜害年份多 climat 合酿实例，并非新增一级园。

body.en: Limestone and marl alternate, with predominantly Upper Jurassic calcareous formations and some Middle Jurassic marl in eastern relief. Eastward-dipping strata produce asymmetric ridges.
body.zh: 石灰岩与泥灰岩交替；以晚侏罗世钙质地层为主，东部部分低丘见中侏罗世泥灰岩。岩层向东倾斜，形成不对称山脊。

body.en: Shallower limestone-derived soils tend to be freer draining; marl-rich positions can have deeper soils and greater water reserves. These are regional tendencies, not identical conditions across an entire named climat.
body.zh: 石灰岩上的浅薄土层通常排水较快；泥灰岩较多的位置可形成较深土层与较强保水能力。这些是区域倾向，不代表每个同名 climat 内部条件完全一致。

body.en: The climat entries identify which observations concern a named producer’s parcel. Slope, soil depth, planted area and vine age retain that source’s scope and date.
body.zh: 各 climat 条目明确标注哪些描述仅适用于某生产者的地块；坡度、土层深度、栽植面积与藤龄保留原资料的适用范围及日期。
主要品种 Chardonnay；辅助品种 Pinot Gris。

body.en: Pinot Noir principal; Chardonnay and Pinot Gris accessory.
body.zh: 主要品种 Pinot Noir；辅助品种 Chardonnay 与 Pinot Gris。

body.en: Accessories: ≤15% per parcel, interplanted only; mixed-planting grapes are vinified together.
body.zh: 辅助品种仅限混栽，每地块合计不超过 15%；混栽地块的葡萄须共同酿造。

body.en: Rully / Rully Premier Cru; 23 recognised Premier Cru climat names. A named climat and a commercial cuvée are different kinds of identity.
body.zh: Rully／Rully Premier Cru；23 个获承认的 Premier Cru climat。climat 名与商业 cuvée 名属于不同层次。

body.en: 21 climats are in Rully. Clos du Chaigne (à Jean de France) and Clos St Jacques are in Chagny.
body.zh: 21 个 climat 位于 Rully；Clos du Chaigne (à Jean de France) 与 Clos St Jacques 位于 Chagny。

body.en: Cloux and Champs Cloux are separate climats. Le Meix Cadot and Le Meix Caillet are separate. Village Les Saint-Jacques is not Premier Cru Clos St Jacques.
body.zh: Cloux 与 Champs Cloux 为不同 climat；Le Meix Cadot 与 Le Meix Caillet 亦不同。Village 级 Les Saint-Jacques 不是 Premier Cru Clos St Jacques。

body.en: Checked 29 October 2026: INAO cites decree 2011-1704; Légifrance marks it in force. The BIVB-linked specification supplies the baseline rules below; annual harvest authorisations remain vintage-specific.
body.zh: 2026 年 10 月 29 日核对：INAO 引用 2011-1704 号法令，Légifrance 标示其有效；以下为 BIVB 当前链接规范的基础规定，年度采收授权须按年份另核。

body.en: ≥8,000 vines/ha; rows ≤1.40 m; vines within rows ≥0.80 m.
body.zh: 至少 8,000 株/ha；行距不超过 1.40 m；同行株距至少 0.80 m。

body.en: Maximum fruitful buds: white 10/vine; red 8/vine. Authorised short-pruning and Guyot systems are specified.
body.zh: 白葡萄酒每株最多 10 个有效芽，红葡萄酒 8 个；规范列明许可短梢及 Guyot 修剪形式。

body.en: Irrigation prohibited. Base yield / ceiling (hl/ha): Village white 60/64, red 54/58; Premier Cru white 58/62, red 52/56.
body.zh: 禁止灌溉。基础产量／极限产量（hl/ha）：Village 白 60/64、红 54/58；Premier Cru 白 58/62、红 52/56。

body.en: Organic or biodynamic farming is producer-specific, not an automatic condition of the appellation. Certifications and current estate practice belong in producer records.
body.zh: 有机或生物动力栽培属于生产者实践，并非产区名称自动保证的条件；认证与现行操作应在酒庄档案中逐一说明。

body.en: Minimum grape sugar: 178/180 g/L; natural alcohol: 11/10.5% vol.
body.zh: 葡萄最低糖度 178／180 g/L；天然潜在酒精度最低 11／10.5% vol。

body.en: Minimum grape sugar: 187/189 g/L; natural alcohol: 11.5/11% vol.
body.zh: 葡萄最低糖度 187／189 g/L；天然潜在酒精度最低 11.5／11% vol。

body.en: These minima concern harvest maturity and natural alcohol, not the finished alcohol printed on every bottle.
body.zh: 这些最低值涉及采收成熟度与天然潜在酒精度，不等于每瓶成酒酒标必须显示的酒精度。

body.en: Direct pressing, barrel fermentation and lees ageing recur in white-wine dossiers. Red-wine examples use differing destemming, whole-cluster, extraction and oak regimes. Exact percentages and durations are wine- and vintage-specific.
body.zh: 白葡萄酒档案常见直接压榨、桶发酵与酒泥熟成；红葡萄酒的去梗、整串、萃取与木桶方案各异。比例和时长必须对应具体酒款及年份。

body.en: Wood pieces and continuous presses prohibited. Red malic acid ≤0.4 g/L at bottling. Fermentable sugars: red ≤2 g/L; white ≤3 g/L, or ≤4 with qualifying acidity.
body.zh: 禁用木片与连续式压榨机。红酒装瓶时苹果酸不超过 0.4 g/L；可发酵糖红酒不超过 2 g/L，白酒不超过 3 g/L，符合酸度条件时可至 4 g/L。

body.en: Minimum élevage to 1 April after harvest; consumer release from 15 April. No compulsory percentage of new oak.
body.zh: 至少熟成至采收翌年 4 月 1 日，面向消费者上市自 4 月 15 日起；无统一强制新桶比例。

body.en: Chardonnay-led dry whites range from citrus and white-fruit freshness to broader lees- and oak-shaped textures. With development, nut, quince or honey notes can appear; producer and vintage determine intensity.
body.zh: 以 Chardonnay 为主的干白可呈柑橘、白色水果与清新结构，也可因酒泥及木桶处理更为宽厚；陈年可发展坚果、榅桲或蜂蜜气息，强度因酒庄与年份而异。

body.en: Pinot Noir-led reds combine cherry and berry fruit with floral or spice tones. Tannin and weight vary materially; youth can show more firmness, while bottle age may soften texture.
body.zh: 以 Pinot Noir 为主的红酒常见樱桃、浆果、花香或香料；单宁及酒体有明显差异，年轻时可较紧实，瓶陈后质地可能更柔和。

body.en: Compare a Village and Premier Cru from the same producer and vintage, then the same climat across producers. This controls more variables than comparing classification alone.
body.zh: 先比较同酒庄、同年份的 Village 与 Premier Cru，再比较不同酒庄的同一 climat；这样比仅按等级比较更能控制变量。

body.en: BIVB guidance: whites 12–14°C; reds 14–16°C. Adjust for concentration, maturity and serving conditions.
body.zh: BIVB 建议白酒 12–14°C、红酒 14–16°C；按浓度、酒龄和实际服务条件调整。

body.en: Whites suit fish, shellfish, poultry with cream and Comté. Reds work with roast poultry, meat sauces or savoury offal preparations; match texture and tannin to the dish.
body.zh: 白酒可配鱼类、贝类、奶油禽肉与 Comté；红酒可配烤禽、肉酱或风味较浓的内脏料理，重点匹配质地与单宁。

body.en: Choose aeration and decanting after tasting the bottle. Avoid a universal ageing window or automatic decanting rule for the entire appellation.
body.zh: 先试饮，再决定醒酒或换瓶；不为整个产区套用统一适饮期或固定醒酒规则。

body.en: BIVB: white 248.34 ha (69.67 ha Premier Cru); red 118.10 ha (27.87 ha Premier Cru).
body.zh: BIVB：白葡萄酒 248.34 ha（其中 Premier Cru 69.67 ha）；红葡萄酒 118.10 ha（其中 Premier Cru 27.87 ha）。

body.en: White 9,772 hl (Premier Cru 2,796); red 4,783 hl (Premier Cru 1,097). These dated averages are not legal yield limits.
body.zh: 白葡萄酒 9,772 hl（Premier Cru 2,796）；红葡萄酒 4,783 hl（Premier Cru 1,097）。这些为有日期的平均产量，不是法定每公顷产量上限。

body.en: Agneux; Champs Cloux; Chapitre; Clos du Chaigne (à Jean de France); Clos St Jacques; Cloux; Grésigny; La Bressande; La Fosse; La Pucelle; La Renarde; Le Meix Cadot; Le Meix Caillet; Les Pierres; Margotés; Marissou; Molesme; Montpalais; Pillot; Préaux; Rabourcé; Raclot; Vauvry.
body.zh: Agneux；Champs Cloux；Chapitre；Clos du Chaigne (à Jean de France)；Clos St Jacques；Cloux；Grésigny；La Bressande；La Fosse；La Pucelle；La Renarde；Le Meix Cadot；Le Meix Caillet；Les Pierres；Margotés；Marissou；Molesme；Montpalais；Pillot；Préaux；Rabourcé；Raclot；Vauvry。

coverage.en: Appellation core, regulatory baseline and all 23 recognised Premier Cru identities reviewed on 29 October 2026. Parcel observations retain producer scope; figures carry their source dates. Annual authorisations and future vintages are separate updates.
coverage.zh: 产区主体、法规基础及全部 23 个获承认 Premier Cru 身份于 2026 年 10 月 29 日核对。地块观察保留生产者范围，数值保留资料日期；年度授权与未来年份属于后续独立更新。
